basic_details.job_title: NITW Project Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Warangal (NITW) is filling one Project Scientist-I post in the MeitY-sponsored project "D⁵C Toolkit: Dataset, Detection, Diagnosis, and Dissemination for Deepfakes and Cyber Threats in Real-World Scenarios". The post is for 2 years at Rs. 77,000 + HRA per month. The essential qualification is a PhD in Electronics and Communication Engineering or Computer Science Engineering plus an M.E./M.Tech, and the age limit is 45 years. Candidates send the completed proforma and a resume by email to [email protected] by 30 November 2026, 11.59 pm.

how_to_apply: Complete the application proforma attached with the advertisement (Application for the position of Project Scientist-I, page 3 of the notice).
Attach a brief resume, curriculum vitae or bio-data with the application form.
Send the soft copy by email to [email protected].
Make sure the email reaches by 30/11/2026, 11.59 pm.

The proforma asks for name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category (OC/OBC/SC/ST), educational qualifications from SSC to Ph.D., test scores, experience, publications and any other relevant information. It ends with a declaration that the statements are true and that the candidate is available for an online interview if necessary. Contact: Prof. T. Kishore Kumar, Professor (HAG), Dept. of ECE, National Institute of Technology Warangal – 506 004, Telangana State, India, phone +91 8332969353, email [email protected].
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The application declaration says that the candidature is liable to be cancelled if information is found false or incorrect, or any ineligibility is detected before or after selection.

content_sections.heading: NITW Project Scientist-I at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

rows.details: D⁵C Toolkit: Dataset, Detection, Diagnosis, and Dissemination for Deepfakes and Cyber Threats in Real-World Scenarios
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Rs. 77,000 + HRA per month for two years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a PhD in Electronics and Communication Engineering or Computer Science Engineering, and a Master's degree in Engineering or Technology (M.E./M.Tech) from a recognised university or equivalent. The age limit is 45 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Adequate experience in programming using Python/MATLAB, with a sound knowledge of the fundamentals of Machine Learning/Deep Learning. Adequate experience in speech Signal Processing, video Processing and basics cybersecurity concepts. The application proforma also asks for GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF scores, research, industrial or teaching experience, and publications or conference participations. The notice does not make any of these compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 77,000 + HRA per month for two years, with HRA as per institute rules. The notice says the position is purely temporary. Selected candidates will get experience as post-doctoral experience.

content_sections.heading: NITW Project Scientist-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Lab experiments Implementation of GUI setup Sample collection and construction of data set Analysis of data Publishing research articles

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NITW Project Scientist-I
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Completed application proforma Brief resume / curriculum vitae / bio-data The proforma asks for name, father's name, date of birth, sex, marital status, category (OC/OBC/SC/ST), educational qualifications from SSC to Ph.D., test scores, experience, publications and any other relevant information. It ends with a declaration that the statements are true and that the candidate is available for an online interview if necessary. Contact: Prof. T. Kishore Kumar, Professor (HAG), Dept. of ECE, National Institute of Technology Warangal – 506 004, Telangana State, India, phone +91 8332969353, email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and also intimated through email or phone. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview, online or offline. If the interview is held online, candidates are expected to have a good internet connection. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The application declaration says that the candidature is liable to be cancelled if information is found false or incorrect, or any ineligibility is detected before or after selection.
